ex.en: The new system eliminated the need for paper forms completely.
ex.zh: 新系统彻底消除了对纸质表格的需要。

words.note: eliminate 强调彻底清除，常用 eliminate sth from sth。

ex.en: Their little girl looked cute in the red hat her grandmother made.
ex.zh: 他们的小女儿戴着奶奶做的红帽子，看起来很可爱。

words.note: cute 口语常用，强调小巧可爱；美式口语也可表精明。

ex.en: Every employee is entitled to two weeks of paid leave each year.
ex.zh: 每位员工每年有权享受两周带薪假期。

words.note: entitle 双重含义：给权利、给书名，如 be entitled to。

ex.en: The professor asked us to write an outline before starting the essay.
ex.zh: 教授要求我们写文章前先写提纲。

words.note: outline 作动词指「概述」；in outline 表粗略地。

ex.en: The office was divided by a glass partition into two small rooms.
ex.zh: 办公室被一道玻璃隔断分成两个小间。

words.note: partition 指隔墙或分割行为；partition into 表分成。

ex.en: Members pay only a nominal fee to use the sports centre.
ex.zh: 会员只需付象征性费用就能使用体育中心。

words.note: nominal 指名义上的或极少的，如 nominal fee。

ex.en: The airline charges extra for baggage in excess of twenty kilos.
ex.zh: 行李超过二十公斤，航空公司会额外收费。

words.note: in excess of 表「超过」，比 more than 正式。

ex.en: She glanced at her watch and realized she was already late.
ex.zh: 她看了看表，意识到自己已经迟到了。

words.note: glance at 强调快速看一眼；stare at 是盯着看。

ex.en: Travelling abroad gave him a new perspective on his own culture.
ex.zh: 出国旅行让他对自己国家的文化有了新的看法。

words.note: from the perspective of 表从…角度；强调看问题的立场。

ex.en: The new telescope can capture images of a distant galaxy with great clarity.
ex.zh: 这台新望远镜能非常清晰地拍摄遥远星系的图像。

words.note: galaxy 指星系；特指银河系时用 the Galaxy。

ex.en: The law was passed to guarantee equality of opportunity in education.
ex.zh: 该法律的通过是为了保障教育机会平等。

words.note: equality of opportunity 是固定搭配；形容词是 equal。

ex.en: The storm caused widespread destruction along the coast.
ex.zh: 风暴沿海岸造成了广泛破坏。

words.note: destroy（动词）+ -tion 构成名词；不可数，不加 a。

ex.en: The tax increase provoked a rebellion among small business owners.
ex.zh: 增税在小企业主中引发了反抗。

words.note: rebel 名词重音在前、动词在后；rebellion 是名词。

ex.en: Her facial expression told me the news was worse than she had said.
ex.zh: 她的面部表情告诉我，消息比她说的更糟。

words.note: expression 可指表情、词语或表达方式。

ex.en: The announcement produced an angry reaction from local residents.
ex.zh: 这一宣布引起了当地居民的愤怒反应。

words.note: reaction to 后接引发反应的事；动词是 react。

ex.en: The goods were delivered in accordance with the terms of the contract.
ex.zh: 货物已按合同条款交付。

words.note: accordance 只用于 in accordance with 短语中。

ex.en: After ten hours on the road, the weary travellers finally reached home.
ex.zh: 在路上走了十个小时后，疲惫的旅客终于到家。

words.note: weary of 表「厌倦」；weary 是形容词，不是动词。

ex.en: The charity appealed to the public for donations after the flood.
ex.zh: 洪水过后，慈善机构向公众呼吁捐款。

words.note: appeal to 可表「吸引」或「呼吁」；appealing 有吸引力。

ex.en: The office was swamped with calls after the advertisement appeared.
ex.zh: 广告登出后，办公室的电话应接不暇。

words.note: swamp 作动词常用被动 be swamped with，表应接不暇。

ex.en: The young entrepreneur started her company in a small garage.
ex.zh: 这位年轻企业家在一间小车库里创办了公司。

words.note: entrepreneur 源自法语，指创业者、企业家。

ex.en: She dedicated her career to improving rural education.
ex.zh: 她把职业生涯献给了改善农村教育。

words.note: dedicate to 中 to 为介词，后接名词或动名词。

ex.en: A narrow peninsula stretches out into the sea from the coast.
ex.zh: 一条狭窄的半岛从海岸延伸入海。

words.note: pen-（几乎）+ insula（岛）＝半岛。

ex.en: Extensive research has been done on the effects of screen time on children.
ex.zh: 关于屏幕时间对儿童影响的研究已大量展开。

words.note: extensive 强调范围广；动词是 extend，名词 extension。

ex.en: The city has banned heavy trucks from residential areas at night.
ex.zh: 该市禁止重型卡车夜间进入住宅区。

words.note: residential 指住宅的，与 commercial 相对。

ex.en: I will definitely come to your birthday party on Saturday.
ex.zh: 周六我一定会来参加你的生日聚会。

words.note: definitely 比 certainly 更口语；注意拼写无 a。

ex.en: He felt a sharp stab of pain in his knee while running.
ex.zh: 跑步时他感到膝盖一阵刺痛。

words.note: stab 指用尖器刺；stab sb in the back 也表背信弃义。

ex.en: They had to abandon the plan when the funding was cut.
ex.zh: 资金被削减后，他们不得不放弃这个计划。

words.note: abandon 比 give up 正式，含彻底舍弃之意。

ex.en: The study was carried out in collaboration with three local hospitals.
ex.zh: 这项研究是与三家当地医院合作进行的。

words.note: in collaboration with 表合作；动词是 collaborate。

ex.en: Her speech inspired many young people to join the volunteer programme.
ex.zh: 她的演讲激励许多年轻人加入志愿者项目。

words.note: inspire 表「鼓舞」或「赋予灵感」；名词是 inspiration。

ex.en: Good teachers impart not only knowledge but also a love of learning.
ex.zh: 好老师不仅传授知识，还传达对学习的热爱。

words.note: impart 比 give 正式，常接 knowledge、skills。
